questions.stem: What is a potometer used to measure?

options.text: The rate of mineral absorption by roots
The rate of water uptake by a plant shoot
The amount of sugar produced by leaves
The rate of photosynthesis in a plant

questions.explanation: A potometer measures the rate of water uptake by a plant shoot. Since most water taken up is lost through transpiration (about 99%), this gives a good estimate of the transpiration rate.
